purpose: Locate source-positive losses in existing raw44 and ridge8 retrieval predictions without fitting or changing rankings
population: Every source-known original-training query in the unchanged five native component folds, exactly once; outer validation/test rankings are not analyzed
candidate_union: Direct source labels on the existing shared joint_ids candidate roster, recomputed separately for each fold; no new nomination or replacement
assignment: For each observed positive label: validated saved abstention reason takes precedence; else test candidate-label union, selected-neighbor label union, then original vote ranking top10. Every positive belongs to exactly one bucket. A non-abstaining query whose neighbors have no labels is not reclassified as a descriptor abstention.
verification: Verify the exact original seal, closed minimized input inventory, all fold receipts and files, and original summary bindings before analysis
Require each fold receipt hash to match the fold_receipts binding in the exact pinned original summary, which in turn binds the existing candidate and ranking files
Reconstruct native components and original/inner folds from retained identities and duplicate ledger; require exact query identities, source labels and component assignments
Require each candidate to be an eligible original-training row outside the query fold and at most one candidate per component
Require saved neighbors to be unique eligible candidates with no heldout component leakage
Independently replay all positive-label vote counts and complete rankings with native genre ID tie breaks
Reproduce saved per-component hit10 counts for every arm and independently reproduce the fold-local recording popularity ranking
Reject omitted, duplicate or unexpected queries, inconsistent abstentions, changed source bytes and unclosed inventories

reporting.counts: Query, labeled-query, positive-incidence, component, abstention-reason, neighbor-coverage and genre-ranking-coverage counts remain explicit
reporting.positive_weighting: Bucket incidence count divided by all observed positive incidences, including unsupported queries
reporting.component_weighting: For each component with at least one source positive, divide bucket incidences by its positive count, then average those component fractions equally
reporting.empty_annotations: Remain in query coverage denominators; excluded only from undefined positive-recovery ratios; no missing tag is treated as a negative
reporting.controls: Report original Recall@10 on the same full denominators, not a filtered supported subset
reporting.conservation: Both the integer bucket totals and the component-equal fractions must conserve all positives; recovered bucket must reproduce original Recall@10
reporting.uncertainty: No new significance test or interval: deterministic census conditional on fixed, previously inspected predictions and overlapping training folds

interpretation: Ordered accounting, not causal attribution or an achievable counterfactual oracle
Source annotation recovery is not musical similarity or recommendation usefulness
No claim of untouched evaluation, population generalization, statistical significance or parity improvement
No model fitting, calibration, parameter or candidate-pool search, prediction changes, audio acquisition, serving integration or public deployment
